descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-94609 AC 2, AC 3, AC 4, Spec 1 · “General Feedback Survey set to once daily and shows at around 4–5 PM”.

Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S14 TFA-94609 survey triggers (PR #86, not on main): baseline re-offers across the first week, daily feedback around 4-5 PM, the task-reminder survey once at pilot end

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T5 Baseline trigger rules: once at pilot start before first real use; 'Not now' dismisses it; it shows 2-3 more times that week, no more than once a day, then stops; once answered it never shows again (TFA-94609 Spec 1; TFA-94609 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-94609 ready for pr
  • T3 The General Feedback survey shows once per day, at around 4-5 PM (end of the rounding day, not morning), dismissible, no forced completion (TFA-94609 AC 3; TFA-94609 Spec 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94609 ready for pr
  • T4 All surveys are dismissible, with no forced completion (TFA-94609 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-94609 ready for pr
  • U9b The Task-Reminder survey fires once, at pilot end only, with the specified copy: 'When you dismissed a task reminder, was it usually because you'd already done it, or because it wasn't relevant anymo … (UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1; TFA-94609 AC 2; TFA-94609 Spec 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-94609 ready for pr

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Fresh physician; the device clock under the harness's control; the pilot end date set by the pilot team

When Baseline: Not now on day 1, then open the app on days 2-7 (twice on day 2). Feedback: open the lists at 15:59, 16:00, 17:00 and 17:01; dismiss on one day, answer on the next. Task reminder: open the lists before the end date and on it, answer (or Not now), open again the next day

Then Baseline: offered at most once a day, 2-3 more times in the week after the first Not now, then never; never after an answer. Feedback: not before about 4 PM, shown once that day, dismissible with no forced completion, back the next day. Task reminder: not shown before the end date; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94609 Spec 1 / Spec 3 / Spec 4 / AC 1-4. 'Once' vs re-offer is Q1; whose clock and whether 5 PM is a cutoff is Q14; who owns the end-of-pilot survey is Q7. Main has none of these rules (24 h snooze every day, recorded in S13 R7; feedback only in Settings; surveyResponses accepts only baseline, handoff_followup, feedback); they arrive with PR #86

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev/newspec-c.
